outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmentation/rendering of the pre-conoidal rings and apical polar ring from cryo-electron tomography, not a plot of averaged data; no individual data points are required.
Panel B is a 3D segmentation/rendering showing cytoplasmic actin bundles and IMC, not a quantitative plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with highlighted filaments, not a bar/summary plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel D is a 3D model/rendering illustrating actin populations within the cell, not a data plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged tomographic volume shown as a micrograph-like image, not a bar/summary statistics plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a specific filament-density connection, not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
